title: Depth Relative to K-Trivial Oracles
statement: For a $K$-trivial oracle $A$, is $A$-depth strictly stronger than depth, or does $A$-depth coincide with depth? More generally, which of these two cases occurs for $K$-trivial oracles?
background:
Collected from Oberwolfach Reports, which document mathematical workshops and their open-problem discussions.

**Source report:** [Computability Theory (2022), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2021/21, pp. 1149--1190](https://doi.org/10.4171/owr/2021/21)

## Literature review (checked 2026-08-22)

**Status:** open

**Assessment.** Relativized depth has been developed and its basic preservation theorems proved, but for K-trivial oracles the central alternatives in the queued question are explicitly left open.
